title: ALPCAHUS: Subspace Clustering for Heteroscedastic Data
abstract: arXiv:2505.18918v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Principal component analysis (PCA) is a key tool in the field of data dimensionality reduction. Various methods have been proposed to extend PCA to the union of subspace (UoS) setting for clustering data that comes from multiple subspaces like K-Subspaces (KSS). However, some applications involve heterogeneous data that vary in quality due to noise characteristics associated with each data sample. Heteroscedastic methods aim to deal with such mixed data quality. This paper develops a heteroscedastic-based subspace clustering method, named ALPCAHUS, that can estimate the sample-wise noise variances and use this information to improve the estimate of the subspace bases associated with the low-rank structure of the data. This clustering algorithm builds on K-Subspaces (KSS) principles by extending the recently proposed heteroscedastic PCA method, named LR-ALPCAH, for clusters with heteroscedastic noise in the UoS setting. translated_title: ALPCAHUS：面向异方差数据的子空间聚类
translated_abstract: 主成分分析（PCA）是数据降维领域的关键工具。为了将PCA扩展到子空间并集（UoS）设置以对来自多个子空间的数据进行聚类，已有多种方法被提出，例如K-Subspaces（KSS）。然而，某些应用涉及异质数据，其质量因每个数据样本所关联的噪声特性不同而存在差异。异方差方法旨在处理这种数据质量参差不齐的情况。本文提出了一种基于异方差的子空间聚类方法，命名为ALPCAHUS，该方法能够估计逐样本的噪声方差，并利用这些信息来改进与数据低秩结构相关的子空间基的估计。该聚类算法建立在K-Subspaces（KSS）原理之上，将最近提出的异方差PCA方法LR-ALPCAH扩展到UoS设置下具有异方差噪声的聚类场景中。仿真实验……
tldr: 本文提出ALPCAHUS方法，通过估计每个样本的噪声方差，将异方差PCA扩展到子空间并集聚类中，从而提升对质量参差不齐数据的低秩子空间基估计与聚类效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ALPCAHUS, a heteroscedastic subspace clustering method that extends heteroscedastic PCA to the union-of-subspaces setting by estimating sample-wise noise variances to improve the estimation of low-rank subspace bases for clustering mixed-quality data.
